# Paper (IEEE conference format, two columns)

* `main.tex` — the paper (`\documentclass[conference]{IEEEtran}`); `refs.bib` — verified references; `tables/` — generated by `python -m src.make_ieee_tables`;
  `figs/` — copies of figures from `results/plots/`; `main.pdf` — the compiled paper (6 pages).
* Build: `tectonic -X compile main.tex` (installed with `brew install tectonic`; it needs network access the first time to fetch the IEEE class and fonts).
* Before submission: replace the author and affiliation placeholders in `main.tex`; confirm every reference on its publisher page (the survey in
  `docs/literature_survey.md` lists what was verified and what was not); run your institution's similarity checker.
* The text is original wording written for this project and cites every external work it relies on; no similarity score is claimed.
